extraction_notes: Only SI-reported experimental catalyst-performance data were extracted. Characterization tables/figures (SI Figures S1, S6, S7; SI Tables S1-S2) and activation-energy/Arrhenius data (SI Figure S9) were out of scope. SI Figure S2 contains dense temperature/pressure series; individual bar/point values could not be read reliably from the provided SI image, so those performance points were not extracted. For SI Figures S3, S4, S5 and S8, values are approximate readings from plots unless a printed label is noted. Conditions for SI Figures S4 and S5 are not stated in the SI excerpt; therefore temperature, pressure, feed and GHSV are left null for those records.
